raw.query: WITH per_model_cell AS (SELECT resolution, variate, model, MIN(wape) AS best_wape FROM provenance.forecast_metrics WHERE model IN ('chronos','timesfm','toto','naive','ewma','holt_winters') GROUP BY resolution, variate, model), classical AS (SELECT resolution, variate, MIN(best_wape) AS best_classical_wape FROM per_model_cell WHERE model IN ('naive','ewma','holt_winters') GROUP BY resolution, variate), comparisons AS (SELECT f.resolution, f.variate, f.model, f.best_wape, c.best_classical_wape, f.best_wape < c.best_classical_wape AS beats_every_classical FROM per_model_cell f JOIN classical c USING (resolution, variate) WHERE f.model IN ('chronos','timesfm','toto')), cell_summary AS (SELECT resolution, variate, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE beats_every_classical) AS fm_wins, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT beats_every_classical) AS fm_failures FROM comparisons GROUP BY resolution, variate) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comparisons) AS comparison_denominator, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT (resolution, variate)) FROM comparisons) AS cell_denominator, (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE beats_every_classical) FROM comparisons) AS supported_comparisons, (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT beats_every_classical) FROM comparisons) AS failed_comparisons, (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE fm_failures = 0) FROM cell_summary) AS cells_all_three_win, (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE fm_failures > 0) FROM cell_summary) AS cells_with_any_failure, (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE fm_failures = 3) FROM cell_summary) AS cells_all_three_fail, (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('resolution', resolution, 'comparisons', n, 'failures', failures) ORDER BY resolution) FROM (SELECT resolution, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT beats_every_classical) AS failures FROM comparisons GROUP BY resolution) r) AS per_resolution, (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('resolution', resolution, 'variate', variate, 'model', model, 'fm_wape', best_wape, 'best_classical_wape', best_classical_wape) ORDER BY resolution, variate, model) FROM comparisons WHERE NOT beats_every_classical) AS failures
raw.observed: 44 of 60 model-cell comparisons succeed and 16 fail; all three models win in 11 of 20 cells, while 9 cells have at least one failure and 2 cells have all three fail.
raw.claimed: Three pretrained time-series foundation models beat every tested fixed-parameter classical baseline in all twenty (resolution, signal) cells
raw.evidence: forecast_metrics contains 20 cells, but 16 of 60 comparisons fail; for example, at 1min/ctx the best classical WAPE is 0.3827355809461447 versus 0.38928496938744 for Chronos, 0.3853833427978712 for TimesFM, and 0.38482784156650457 for Toto.
